_doc: Rules from Analista/Rastreador research docs. gate.py enforces every rule here before any publish. A solved research doc whose actions are not covered here must get a rule added BEFORE producing. Never delete a rule unless its research doc is 'failed' and a replacement rule exists.

rules.text: Never upload the same video file twice to the same platform (no delete-and-reupload).
Max 3 TikToks per calendar day (America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires), at least 3 h between publish/schedule times.
Content Check Lite in TikTok Studio read before posting; if it warns 'Content may be restricted', do NOT post: change the video and run the gate again.
Experiment: the first TikTok of each day has no mention of YouTube in its caption (CTA spoken only).
Spoken hook starts at 0.0 s: leading silence <= 0.15 s.
Hook text on screen from frame 1: first caption chunk starts <= 0.3 s.
Spoken hook (first sentence of the script) is 10 words or fewer.
No logo, title card or slow camera move in the first 2 s (check the frame-1 still).
Do not judge, delete or edit-repost a TikTok before 24 h; earlier TikToks of the batch were left untouched.
First frame is the most striking image of the story (not an establishing shot), with the hook as on-screen text (check the frame-1 still).
Publish/schedule time (--at) must be one of the slots the Rastreador set in studio/schedule.json for that platform and format.
Shorts last 30-60 s (never the 100+ s cuts that got 0.4% completion on TikTok).
Right after the YouTube video (short or episode) is live, pin our own comment with one concrete question about the new lore clue (e.g. 'What do you think is on T. Rowe's memory card?').
The caption asks the viewer one concrete question about the story (contains '?'), e.g. 'Would you cut the line?'.
Reel meets Buffer auto-publish limits: 3 s-15 min, <=300 MB, aspect between 4:5 and 9:16, <=1920 px wide.

Buffer post is type reel with automatic publishing (not notification publishing); afterwards get_post shows status sent with the Instagram link. Every short also goes to Instagram Reels, plus the episode Part 1.
